basic_info.description: Welcome to 495 Bright St, a beautifully designed and remodeled 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home on the north slope of Merced Heights. Spanning two levels, this residence offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and breathtaking ocean views. As you enter, you'll be greeted by an inviting living space. Step inside to a light-filled, open-concept layout featuring high-end finishes throughout with hardwood floors. Every detail has been thoughtfully crafted. The spacious living + dining room flows seamlessly into a modern kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances featuring Blue Star, Bosch and U-line. Quartz countertops, custom cabinetry and safety features make this home the perfect blend of modern elegance. Both bedrooms and bath are on the upper level, one offering an ocean view. On the garden level work from home comfortably with a dedicated office space that offers privacy without sacrificing style. Outside dine alfresco with friends and family in your private yard. Large garage for parking and storage w/Bosch washer + dryer and tankless hotwater heater. Near Stonestown with Whole Foods, Trader Joes and more. Easy access to downtown, South Bay, public trans. Experience the best of San Francisco living with this exceptional property. 495 Bright, when you're here you're home.
